title: Mentor discovery and safe connection
goal: Discover verified profiles and request facilitator-mediated introductions.
acceptanceCriteria: Unverified profiles are not shown publicly; connection requests require consent, facilitator mediation and guardian/institution approval flags. Contact details are not returned.
prototypeBoundaries: In-memory stores reset on process restart.
Demo actor headers are not authentication.
Do not claim live external integrations or real opportunities unless verified.
